result:
I re-checked all seven Nova games from the 0.3.1 review at one pinned build (master `e48514f980`). Two glitches still happen, and I found a new frame-rate problem along the way. Every game has a verdict comment with evidence on #265. PR #267 is marked ready and contains only `docs/lanes/gamecheck/NOTES.md`.

| Game | Result |
|---|---|
| Spikeout (PAL disc) | **Still happens.** The intro and attract video is covered in solid green blocks; the subtitles and title screen are clean. |
| Galleon | **Still happens (already tracked as #77).** The stipple and hatching show in the lava-cave attract demo with no input at all, which may give #77 the repeatable scene it lacked. |
| Crimson Skies | **Fixed.** Skipping the boot intro and the mission-opening cutscene both work, straight into flight. |
| RalliSport 2 (PAL disc) | **Not seen, but a weak verdict.** In a race the player car looks intact, but the race runs at 1–2 fps, too slow to judge a subtle rendering fault. |
| Tork | **Nothing measurably wrong.** The level ambience is a steady looping bed with no clipping, dropouts or clicks. The review never says what was wrong, so a person needs to listen to the WAV excerpts. |
| Grabbed by the Ghoulies | **Gameplay not reached.** The story intro runs at 3–11 fps and didn't finish in about 7 minutes of button presses. |
| Conker | **Gameplay not reached.** The single-player loading screen stopped producing frames for over 2.5 minutes. |

**New problems, marked on #265 for the board to file:**
- **Frame-rate collapse:** In-game scenes drop to 1–7 fps in Ghoulies, the RalliSport 2 race and Conker's menu, while menus and video run at 59 fps. The board has already filed the Ghoulies case as #311; the other two show the same pattern. It isn't frame-capture overhead or device overheating. The reviewer played all three games at 2× resolution on 0.3.1, so this may be a regression since then. I haven't tracked down which change caused it.
- **Conker's load stall:** described in the table above.
- **Conker won't launch through the dispatcher:** both queued runs failed to start the game, although starting it by hand works. It is the only file on the device with `&` in its name; that's a suspect, not a confirmed cause.

**Process notes:**
- **Holds:** I took two, both now lifted. A 2-minute one to list the games folder, because two early runs failed on guessed filenames (several of the discs are PAL, not USA). And a 30-minute one for the hand-driven checks, placed while my own run was active so the device stayed on the pinned build.
- **Crimson Skies false crash:** my first attempt died mid-menu. The log showed an outside force-stop from `stop-emulator.sh`, which fires at every agent turn end in any session unless the device's lease is kept fresh, so it was not a game crash. I renewed the Nova's lease for the rest of the hold. The NOTES cover this, plus the flaky adb connection (roughly one call in five failed) and the controller's real d-pad codes, which `pad.sh` gets wrong. Both matter for the scripted-input work.
- **Preflight:** every check passes except `coverage`. That one fails on #315's classification in the board's files, which lanes don't edit, so it isn't caused by this docs-only change.

Frames, logs, WAVs and helper scripts are in `/home/justin/hakux-work/gamecheck/`.
